reviewer: Primary agent, actual reference and screenshot interpretation; not independent review
request: Find light/dark values, add textured leaf self-shadowing on branches/trunks, lighten dirt texture
confirmedCauses: Canonical wood batches cast shadows but receiveShadow was false.
Foliage highlight response had a narrow value range despite strong directional sun.
Ground artwork albedo and canopy cover limited sunlit dirt values.
referenceSampling: Foliage: upper concept region with green/gold chroma filter; wood: manually annotated near-birch polygon; soil: central lower brown chroma region. Approximate photographic reference segmentation, not semantic ground truth.
renderSampling: Actual rendered material IDs: foliage=1, source wood=2, terrain=3; brown chroma filter isolates soil from moss.

decisions.reason: Real alpha-cutout leaf shadows now break up formerly flat wood; no painted shadow decal or bark cookie.
Crown P95 rose 116 to 148 but still too compressed.
Warm selected exterior leaves reach P99 225; shaded leaves remain near P05 48; exposure unchanged.
Soil P95 reached 207, closer numerically, but the foreground washed out and lost framing. Better metrics were not artistic approval.
Lighter warm dirt and luminous middle-distance patches retain dark foreground framing and real leaf-shadow detail.

holdout.finding: Lighting separation/staging retained; simplified foliage and exposed branch scaffolds remain visible.

reusableFindings.principle: Verify both castShadow and receiveShadow before adding procedural self-shadow approximations.
Calibrate high/low display values separately; retain selective high-value leaves instead of increasing whole-scene exposure.
reusableFindings.constraint: Reference segmentation approximate; palette and gains temperate-specific.

reusableFindings.principle: Broad terrain illumination gain is acceptable solely because its luminance percentiles match the concept.

remaining: Foliage P95 is still below concept; the bright accents exist but cover a smaller fraction of leaves.
Dirt still has fewer luminous pixels than concept. Stronger broad gain was deliberately rejected.
Large spray geometry softens leaf-shadow shapes; branch architecture and fern faceting remain simplified.
No mobile GPU testing; coarse-pointer map resolution remains 1024.
